events.strFilename: Boxing 2026-09-12 Ryan Garcia vs Conor Benn
events.strDescriptionEN: Ryan Garcia defends his WBC welterweight title against Conor Benn at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas, with Garcia making the first defence of the belt he won earlier in 2026 and Benn challenging for a world title for the first time. Garcia brings speed and explosive counterpunching, while Benn’s aggressive pressure and physical style make this one of the most intriguing welterweight matchups of the year.
events.strResult: Ryan Garcia retained his WBC welterweight title with a devastating second-round stoppage of Conor Benn at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas. After a sharp opening round, Garcia dropped Benn with a powerful counter right hand in the second and immediately pressed the advantage, forcing the referee to stop the fight at 1:25 as Benn remained badly hurt. The victory moved Garcia to 26–2 with 21 knockouts and strengthened his position at the top of the welterweight division.
